title: Quoin
summary: QUOIN, noun [See Coin]. 1. A corner. 2. An instrument to raise any thing; a wedge employed to raise cannon to a proper level, and for other purposes. 3. In architecture, the corner of a brick or stone

inlines.v: QUOIN, noun [See Coin]. 1. A corner. 2. An instrument to raise any thing; a wedge employed to raise cannon to a proper level, and for other purposes. 3. In architecture, the corner of a brick or stone wall.
